newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France in Air Canada cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Air France in Air Canada cooperation.

text.p: Air France Industries, the aircraft maintenance unit of the state-owned Air France airline, has signed an agreement in principle on maintenance cooperation with Air Canada, aimed at cutting costs.

Under the terms of the deal, Air France will inspect and maintain Air Canada's Boeing B747 jumbo jets every 18 months and five or six years, while the Canadian airline will maintain engines and B767 aircraft flown by Air France, the French company said in a statement.
The agreement will allow each airline to specialise on maintenance and reduce production volumes.
The two companies will continue detailed technical and financial talks in the coming weeks with a view to signing a definitive agreement by the end of the year.
